text: Doc-reference peek rendering — expand a doc chip in place to show the referenced section read-only (SPEC key decision 19 names this as future work). Wants heading-anchor support for per-section peeks.
Doc-reference heading anchors — recognize plans/foo.md#slug in the doc token and scroll/peek to that heading. SPEC key decision 19.
Doctor-style existence check for doc references — validation warns when a .md path in node text points at a missing file, catching renames. SPEC key decision 19.

Decide wayfinder map convention after comparing zigzog (prose in docs/wayfinder/<slug>.md, tickets as nodes) with mediref-svelte (all nodes). If the markdown variant wins: port zigzog's Wayfinding operations section into examples/wayfinder/issue-tracker.md + packages/cli/src/wayfinder-docs.ts (identity test), amend SPEC key decision 19 / wayfinder notes, release, then re-run kalamu init --wayfinder in mediref-svelte
